reason.en: The official summary says Proposition 13 "Authorizes imposition of special taxes by local government (except on real property) by 2/3 vote of qualified electors."

sourceTitle.en: California Ballot Pamphlet, Primary Election, June 6, 1978: Proposition 13, Official Title and Summary (UC Law SF California Ballot Propositions database)

summary.en: Limited property taxes to 1% of a property's value, set 1975–76 assessed values as the base, required a two-thirds vote of the Legislature to raise state taxes, and allowed local governments to impose special taxes only with a two-thirds vote of local voters.
